journey.heading: About Ayush Nandi
paragraphs: I'm Ayush Nandi, a Full Stack Developer and AI Builder from West Bengal, India.
Alongside my academic journey, I build modern web applications, experiment with AI, contribute to open-source projects, and work on digital products through AUX Studio.
I enjoy turning ideas into scalable products that solve real-world problems.
